title: 打勾勾，然後放開
checks: 只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. Cinematic live-action, realistic continuous movement. One uninterrupted close-up of the exact same two adult womens hands and sleeves. At the beginning, their already interlocked pinkies gently squeeze once, without thumbs touching. Next, the grip relaxes naturally. Toward the end, each pinky slowly uncurls and the hands separate by 3 centimeters. Finish with both hands relaxing. Preserve each five-finger hand anatomy and two wrists. Camera physically slides 5 centimeters right with modest parallax. No finger morphing, no additional hands, no letters. Natural soft neutral light. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 10.125 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Quiet hospital atrium ambience with a light spacious reverberation and subtle clothing rustle. No public announcements or unrelated voices.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
